# Bacchus Wine Bistro

> French Restaurant in St. Petersburg, Florida. Nearly 100 wines, charcuterie boards and a sidewalk patio on 2nd Ave NE.

- Phone: (727) 258-8566
- Address: 124 2nd Ave NE, St. Petersburg, FL 33701
- Areas: St. Petersburg, Gulfport, Pinellas Park, St. Pete Beach, Treasure Island
- Offers: Charcuterie and cheese; Plates; Wine and happy hour
- Rating: 4.7 from 778 Google reviews
